name: Tozawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tozawa village emblem in white: a stylised swirl of curved strokes with a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tozawa, a village in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1965.

features.role: Tozawa village emblem — a stylised swirl of curved strokes with a small disc
